primary_experiment: Nominal 1x, synthetic LiDAR 20Hz, one paired seed (101), real driver+PTY vs real FAST-LIO; same real NDT backend
additional_tests: Static reference and 1.5x pressure tests with noise seeds 101/202. Accelerated results are not nominal-rate evidence.
map_change: Remove 12x4m cloth frontage; expose a back wall 3m deeper; preserve primary walls and three pillars.
obstacles: Two new kiosks and 18 moving cylindrical pedestrians; no physical collision simulation.
sensors: 2cm xyz point noise, instantaneous 32-ring XYZIRT snapshots; hypothetical 200Hz IMU with .02m/s^2 acceleration noise and .002rad/s gyro noise plus calibrated startup bias.
initialization: Controlled tracking: accurate initial pose at 5s after both frontends warm up; first NDT cloud at 5.2s; motion starts at 8s.
fairness: All pairs have equal canonical sensor-value hashes, equal prior maps and equal normalized NDT settings; nominal inputs also match the accelerated sequence exactly.
truth_usage: Truth generates synthetic sensor measurements and evaluation only; neither estimator receives truth odometry. Prescribed trajectory prevents estimator-dependent paths.
limitations: Synthetic hall, not the real airport or user LVI-SAM PCD.
No spinning-scan distortion, reflections, real sensor extrinsic error, tire slip or calibrated motor model.
One nominal paired seed and two accelerated noise seeds do not establish general statistical superiority.
The experiment measures localization, not full Nav2 planning, human avoidance or collision safety.
Wheel feedback latency/quantization is idealized; 1% gain is an assumption, not a measured calibration.
The static reference was generated live and ran slower than the cached nominal/pressure replay; do not use it for throughput comparisons.
Displayed fitness is an optimizer score, not a calibrated probability.
engineering_observation: FAST-LIO installed ARM build flags define MP_PROC_NUM=1 without MP_EN; primary observed advantage includes timeliness/compute throughput.
